title: benchmarks.py nav_result parses claude stream-json tested only on synthetic streams
goal: _tools/fixtures/ holds one recorded stream-json of a navigation run (paths, hosts and names replaced by placeholders), and a test in _tools/test_benchmarks.py runs nav_result and nav_files over it, as kb/_self/code.md asks for a check that parses a tool's output

run: import pathlib;assert list(pathlib.Path('_tools/fixtures').rglob('*navigation*')),'no recorded navigation stream under _tools/fixtures'

gates.question: No recorded stream-json of a navigation run exists on this host: the benchmark keeps only parsed fields, and the one real stream of a read-only run is a sprint session with private content and no result event. A fixture needs one fresh paid claude -p navigation run (one case, sonnet, hooks off) over a clone, then trimmed and redacted. Run it?
options: Run one paid navigation case now with its raw stdout kept, then redact and trim it into _tools/fixtures/navigation
Change bench_lookup.nav_run to keep each run's raw stdout beside the parsed row (a separate item), so the next paid navigation run records a stream
Drop the bug: nav_result stays tested on synthetic streams only
gates.recommendation: Run one paid navigation case now with its raw stdout kept, then redact and trim it into _tools/fixtures/navigation
